definition: Input atom IDs/types/masses, cell, positions and velocities; finite physical state; temperature and E+K consistency.
limitation: No original per-case scalar arrays recovered.

definition: Independent checkpoint energy/force/stress on original and translated, rotated, strained, permuted, neighbor-change and vacancy inputs.
result_detail: stage pass flags plus recovered evaluator definition
limitation: Not a held-out performance test or a proof of all symmetry cases.

definition: NVE and configured NVT/NPT internal force frames; actual continuous native-restart replay; 32-step trusted trajectory; 200-step rebuild and strain probe.
horizon: 65 steps small/large; 257 steps medium, plus separate 32/200-step probes
result_detail: stage pass flags; three small-NVE worker logs recovered
limitation: Exact observed errors/rebuild counts and all loaded-library receipts are not retained.

definition: NVE and configured ensemble: one continuous 5000-step run each, sampled checkpoint numeric checks, internal force verification, physical statistics, NVE consumed-force consistency and energy drift.
horizon: 5000 steps = 5 ps per ensemble per case
result_detail: stage pass flags plus matched frozen configuration
limitation: Observed drift values and full per-frame numerical arrays are unavailable; 5 ps is not a long-timescale scientific stability claim.

definition: Independent verification of selected timed candidate intervals.
limitation: Separate physical gates do not independently certify every sampled timed trajectory interval.
